datasets.name: Sentinel-1 imagery
datasets.verbatim: We downloaded Sentinel-1 imagery from Copernicus Open Access Hub [45]. ... 45. ESA Copernicus Open Access Hub. Available online: https://scihub.copernicus.eu/dhus/#/home

datasets.name: Landslide inventory of 7837 co-seismic landslides
datasets.verbatim: We utilized a detailed inventory of 7837 co-seismic landslides based on visual interpretation of PlanetScope images by Wang et al. [6] as the basis for our ground truth.

methods.name: Attn-U-Net (Attention U-Net)
methods.summary: A modified U-Net architecture incorporating soft attention gates in the skip connections to suppress irrelevant regions and focus on relevant spatial information, used for pixel-based binary classification of landslides.
methods.verbatim: For the study, we use a modified version of the well-known U-Net, called Attn-U-Net from Abraham et al. [38].

reproducibility_assessment: The Sentinel-1 and DEM datasets are publicly accessible via USGS and Copernicus, but the landslide inventory is only referenced to a publication without a link. The custom Attn-U-Net code is mentioned but lacks a repository or persistent link.
